_comment: Parallel deployment for design iteration. Points at the crm-addon-design Cloud Run service, NOT crm-addon. Named distinctly so it does not collide with the inboxpulse-dev deployment in Gmail's add-on rail — running two identically-titled panels is the exact problem that caused the original deployment to be deleted on 2026-08-03. Register with: gcloud workspace-add-ons deployments create inboxpulse-design --deployment-file=apps/addon/deployment.design.json --project project-y-email-sentiment
